limitations: The timelines remain selective: the first mainly European; the companion adds Chinese and Indian traditions but is not a global survey.
The original timeline order places Mill before Bentham; retained and explicitly labeled as a reversal rather than silently changing source progression.
The requested most popular schools are presented as prominent examples without inventing survey data or a ranked popularity claim.
Moral realism and anti-realism are families with contested boundaries; the page states its robust, stance-independent sense and separates normative from metaethical questions.
The first source glossary has 31 entries. The first 30 remain numbered; Stewardship is retained immediately afterward as a labeled source note with its original node and sequence.
All prior page limitations and all 35 site-native approvals remain effective. No new original-source blocker.
Browser checks are desktop/mobile spot checks, not full accessibility, device or cross-browser certification.
